name: Alex Fernandez
bio: Alex Fernandez is an American actor and voice actor best known for his extensive work on television, video games, and animation. He has built a prolific career spanning over three decades with more than 100 live-action and voiceover credits, notably as National Security Advisor Anthony Prado on Commander in Chief, Rafael "Rafi" Alvarez on Without a Trace, Roy Vickers on Dallas, or Pablo Diaz on Devious Maids.
